_readme: ALL Vastu rules live in this one file. Edit zones, reasons and weights here. Every rule has a 'source' field; replace it when a rule is confirmed against the user's reference images. Zones: N NE E SE S SW W NW C (C = Brahmasthan). Zones not listed in pass/caution/fail count as caution.

marma.description: Marma points on the 9x9 (Paramasayika) grid, in pada units (u = 0 West to 9 East, v = 0 North to 9 South). Major: Mahamarma at the centre plus the corners and side midpoints of the Brahmasthan (diagonals and Vamsha/central lines meeting the Nadi lines 3 and 6). Minor: where the two diagonals (Karna sutras) cross Nadi lines 1, 2, 7, 8.
